releaseTitle: AdSkip Pro v1.0.31 - Self-Targeting HUD Safety Gate, InMobi Decoy Neutralization & Resilient Perception
releaseNotes:
* Safety Gate Protection: Zero-tolerance regex guardrails blocking vision OCR from self-targeting HUD overlay text or status badges
* Corrupted HUD Pattern Purge: Automatic Room DB purging on startup to eliminate errant center-screen clicks
* InMobi Top-Left Native Close: Top-left close button prioritized (score 110) over deceptive top-right 'Close ad' webview redirect
* Resilient Perception Fallback: Dynamic eviction of visual patterns after 3 consecutive misses with automatic fallback to NodeTreeScanner
* Comprehensive Trapped Scan Recovery: Global back-press escape fallback across all perception target types when ads become unresponsive
